verify_note: Proportions and all nine failure checks confirmed against the NPTEL lesson above. Every thickness is a multiple of the ROD diameter; the pin is sized separately and raised when shear or bending needs it, exactly as the lesson's worked problem does.

pin_diameter_d.meaning: pin diameter, before shear and bending raise it
pin_diameter_d.source: Bhandari, Design of Machine Elements, sec 4.12, eq 4.26d

eye_outer_diameter_d2.meaning: outer diameter of eye and fork, d0 = 2d
eye_outer_diameter_d2.source: Bhandari, Design of Machine Elements, sec 4.12, eq 4.26j

head_collar_diameter_d3.source: Bhandari, Design of Machine Elements, sec 4.12, eq 4.26o

eye_thickness_t.meaning: thickness of eye of rod B, b = 1.25D
eye_thickness_t.source: Bhandari, Design of Machine Elements, sec 4.12, eq 4.26n

fork_thickness_t1.meaning: thickness of each fork eye, a = 0.75D
fork_thickness_t1.source: Bhandari, Design of Machine Elements, sec 4.12, eq 4.26m

enlarged_rod_D1.meaning: enlarged rod diameter near the eye and fork, D1 = 1.1D
enlarged_rod_D1.source: Bhandari, Design of Machine Elements, sec 4.12, eq 4.26b

collar_thickness.note: our choice, not a book value; min keeps the taper-pin hole inside the collar

taper_pin_diameter.note: split pin mean diameter = 0.25 x rod diameter (NPTEL IIT KGP M4L2)

fork_clearance.note: gap x between the fork base and the eye, x = 10 mm (Bhandari eq 4.26p)

pin_bending.modes_note: 'size' raises the pin diameter until bending passes; 'check_only' keeps d = D and just reports bending. Books differ: set this to match yours.
pin_bending.formula: sigma_b = 16P (t1/3 + t/4) / (pi d1^3), with t and t1 from the rod diameter
pin_bending.source: NPTEL IIT KGP M4L2 section 4.2.3 check 3
pin_bending.allowable: tension allowable used for bending, UNVERIFIED

preferred_sizes_source: NPTEL IIT KGP M4L2 worked problem: 6-22 mm in 2 mm steps, 25-60 in 5, 60-110 in 10, 110-140 in 15, 140-160 in 20
departs_from_book: The lesson raises the pin to 55 mm for bending but then checks the eye against the original 40 mm pin. With the raised pin in the hole its own eye-shear check reads 80 MPa against 65 allowed, so this tool grows the eye outer diameter instead of copying d2 = 2D. See tests/test_book_problems.py.
